bechacant.project: Web and PWA products built with React, Next.js and TypeScript, with backend services and AI-powered features.
bechacant.responsibilities: Built product features end to end: paywalls and in-app purchases, feeds, content pages, settings and wallet screens. Worked on offline-friendly, mobile-first PWAs with push notifications, and on parts of a code editor UI — editing, tabs, file tree, live preview. On the backend: Node.js services in NestJS and Express with REST and GraphQL, payments and subscriptions including store verification, webhooks and background jobs for expiry and sync, plus PostgreSQL work with safe logging and access rules. Integrated RAG APIs for chat, text generation and assistant features, with prompt design, streaming responses, tool calling and agent-style flows. Wrote specs before coding and kept the docs in sync with the code.
bechacant.interest: Fixing the hard bugs — endless request loops, wrong deep-link routing, timezone drift, layouts collapsing under large system fonts. Also set up shared AI coding rules and prompts for the team.

eteam.role: Full Stack Developer — eTeam, contract, remote
eteam.project: nedyx — a low-code platform for business reporting, built by a small international team.
eteam.responsibilities: Supported and developed the product in React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL and Apollo. Built a dynamic widget system with full visualisation control, large tables, charts and a text editor, reading data from external databases for many users. Implemented undo/redo, archive creation, PDF export and the platform's own functional language.
eteam.interest: A well-thought-out, genuinely dynamic system for business reports — and our own functional language behind it.

danit.responsibilities: Taught a group of 25 students from the beginning: HTML5, CSS3 and Git.
danit.interest: Explaining a thing properly is the fastest way to find the holes in your own understanding.

ugenius.role: Frontend Developer — U-Genius, contract, remote (Ukraine / USA)
ugenius.project: Three applications for LinkSquares — contract lifecycle and legal project management.
